lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Mackenzie Valley Highway becomes first major project of national interest in Canada’s North, The Canadian Press reports.
Newfoundland’s Wakeham only Atlantic premier to react to Supreme Court ruling, The Canadian Press reports.
Marcel Colomb First Nation says its drinking water has taken on a sulphur smell this past week, and people have become ill, The Canadian Press reports.
The federal government says seven teams have been selected to take part in a design competition to restore the prime minister’s official residence at 24 Sussex Drive in, The Canadian Press reports.
A sentencing hearing concluded Friday for Kenneth Law, an Ontario man who sold lethal substances online to people who later used them to take their own lives, The Canadian Press reports.
iRestore’s Black Friday sale cuts up to 58% off LED face masks and hair growth helmets, with savings of up to $470 on select light therapy devices, Fox News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
